Frequently asked questions about Ishmael Barbara
 Sample of 16 matches, from 21/07/2022 to 13/11/2026. Answers refer to the matches in the table and the selected filters.
 Card totals and percentages use yellow plus red cards in this sample.
 What is Ishmael Barbara’s average number of cards per match?
 Ishmael Barbara averages 3.44 yellow cards and 0.13 red cards per match across the 16 matches analysed: 3.56 cards per match in total.
 What are Ishmael Barbara’s penalty statistics?
 Ishmael Barbara has awarded 6 penalties in the 16 matches analysed, averaging 0.38 per match.
 How often does Ishmael Barbara exceed 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 cards?
 Across the 16 matches in the sample, the total exceeded 3.5 cards in 43.8% of matches, 4.5 in 37.5% and 5.5 in 6.3%.
 How much does Ishmael Barbara’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 16 matches analysed, 25.0% ended with 0–2 cards, 68.8% with 3–5 and 6.3% with 6 or more.
 How do Ishmael Barbara’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 3.10 cards, compared with 3.56 across all 16 matches analysed.
 How does Ishmael Barbara distribute yellow cards between home and away teams?
 Across the 16 matches analysed, home teams average 1.69 yellow cards and away teams 1.75. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
